fusions.name: Beady Aim
fusions.desc: Fixes one beady eye on the weak spot and pecks it for 30 damage as a critical hit, leaving the target 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Transfixing Stare
fusions.desc: Stares down a narrow cone 5 tiles long, dealing 10 damage to everything in it and stunning each for 1.2 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Sentry's Cry
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder and fights with 1 more Power for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Noted Threat
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a mark builds on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per mark. Unfed, a mark fades every 4 seconds.
